summary: Accepted the writer-frozen revision 3 at the exact packet SHA recorded below. All 23 atoms, the outline, reference, complete final packet, 148 shared recursive prerequisite bodies and two deduplication comparison pages were actually read. The final checkpoint covers 176 files; all hashes match, and the 171-node prerequisite graph has no cycle or missing destination. DR-F01, DR-F02 and the parent-reported formatting issue are verified resolved. Acceptance covers the stated mathematical, editorial and source-contract scope, not a complete re-proof of the primary papers, a build, rendered-site QA or publication.

resolved_findings.title: Provide the Lieb-Robinson estimate used to obtain quasi-locality
resolved_findings.finding: The outline, quasi-local diagonalization sketch and shell-decomposition note all invoke a Lieb-Robinson bound, but none states its contract or links to a genuine theorem page. A whole-tree search for Lieb-Robinson found only this branch's mentions. In particular, the passage from the summable local generators to a volume-independent distant-commutator bound currently has only a named theorem and an external section pointer.
resolved_findings.correction: Add a reusable atomic statement corresponding to arXiv:2408.04338v2, section 18.2 Theorem 4, with finite lattice, Hermitian local interaction, time dependence, decay kernel, interaction norm and constant uniformity declared. Link it at the actual uses and explain the interface to 4O0D. A precisely cited deep proof or clearly identified proof outline is acceptable; do not label it as a locally complete proof unless supplied.
resolved_findings.acceptance_condition: Read the new theorem and its actual prerequisite destinations, compare its estimate and hypotheses with the original Theorem 4, and verify the changed packet dependency and proof-scope records.
resolved_findings.resolution: Read the final 4O0L finite continuous-interaction Lieb-Robinson theorem and proof, the continuous propagator construction 4O0M, and the explicit convolution weight 4O0N; compared with NSY Theorem 3.1 and its complete proof. 4O00, 4O07 and 4O0D link to the actual theorem. 4O0D supplies the volume-independent interval-to-shell estimate and reverse-conjugation argument. 4O07 explicitly cites the L1-time extension in source Corollaries 5-6, so the continuous local propagator proof is not silently extended. Packet prerequisite/application classification and final hashes match.

checked_contracts: Independent uniform [0,1] random fields, deterministic bounded diagonal coupling, arbitrary exponentially decaying Hermitian interval perturbations
Thermal-bath and initial-state suprema precede the long-time limsup
No absolute value inserted into the heat-current definition; nonnegativity follows from a traceless time-average operator
Theorem 1 exponentially small success lower bound is not a high-probability full-chain localization theorem
Theorem 2 polynomial current bound and fixed-coupling expectation consequence; no claimed exact transport exponent or general MBL

Fixed C_kappa precedes existence of gamma_0,c,c'; constants are uniform in L, gamma and the permitted deterministic coupling data. Theorem 1 gives one unitary for every interval observable on the event.

4O0E uses disjoint blocks whose good events depend only on their internal independent fields. The explicit 3/4 log L construction has a sufficiently-large-L threshold depending on fixed a, and does not claim a uniform gamma threshold.
4O0I distinguishes that elementary large-L proof from the exact uniform finite-size theorem quoted from the primary paper.
4O0J fixes gamma before L tends to infinity, requires alpha(gamma)>1, and estimates the bad event with the uniform all-sample current bound rather than an unjustified dominated-convergence step.

4O0L matches the finite-spin weakening of NSY Theorem 3.1; the local interaction-picture derivative, recursive commutator estimate, F-kernel convolution, time simplex and factorial remainder were checked.

4O0D counts at most 2r pairs at distance r across the boundary of a one-dimensional interval and gets support-size-independent shell bounds; the inverse conjugation uses the swapped-support commutator identity.
4O0K distinguishes bath-optimized current from linear-response conductance, finite-size conductivity and general infinite-chain MBL.
4O07 explicitly separates the continuous local Lieb-Robinson proof from the time-integrable extension cited in original Corollaries 5-6.
Packet claim_sources covers every atom, and each proof_scope distinguishes local proof, cited theorem, proof outline and cited spatial estimate.
Official invited-talk metadata supports report identity only; 2408.04338v2 is an associated research paper and is never represented as the proceedings chapter.

All 148 actual recursive prerequisites were read by the reviewer, including pages the writer honestly marked structural-only. This does not imply every unrelated statement or primary source behind them was independently re-proved.

honestly_unexpanded_proofs.scope: The all-scale nonresonance probability and summable local generator estimates are cited from 2408.04338v2 sections 5-17 and 18.1-18.2; the local text is explicitly a proof outline. No full MBL or full independent reproduction of that proof is claimed.

The diagonal interval expansion and the spatial summation yielding the exponent c/5 are cited from equations 18.12-18.15. The decomposition and all five commutator terms are checked locally; the detailed spatial estimate is explicitly treated as a research input.

The final time-averaging deduction is checked locally conditional on the two preceding research inputs. Uniform finite-size constants are quoted from source Theorem 2, not inferred from the fixed-gamma elementary block lemma.

The L1-in-time extension used for the limiting generator is cited from original section 18.2 Corollaries 5-6. The local 4O0L-4O0M proofs establish the finite continuous case and do not claim a complete local proof of that extension.
